points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact curated d93a1ef clean CMake build succeeds in cfd-bench container; this establishes build only, not valid production results.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:171–180 parses solve, case and output options; no restart option or restart reader found. Output writer claims completion independently of actual residual.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: solver/src separates mesh, numerical, physics and I/O modules, though production main.cpp bypasses reconstruction and limiter modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal call to an external CFD executable found in inspected main/source; external authorship search was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:185–189 parses a case file and reads its configured mesh path rather than branching on two mesh filenames; no full general-mesh validation.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS ownership and halo lists are present (mesh_partition.cpp:42–93,106–248), but full mesh persists on every rank and main.cpp:84–114,311–314 omits global force reduction; all ranks write the same result paths :255–257,335–394.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:255–257,335–394 writes shared paths on each rank; no global force reduction and M015 status reports convergence despite residual growth.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Committed run_manifest documents unfinished cases; no focused automated tests found in curated solver tree, and only one current package has metadata.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated tree separates solver modules and report; raw results are untracked and their source binding is unknown.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
